sections.title: FAQ — Dynamics 365 & Microsoft Power Platform Development

items.question: Does Ø Studio offer mobile application development?
items.answer: Yes. Our Microsoft application development services consider accessibility from mobile devices and cybersecurity as core components of the app development process. If you want a web or mobile application designed with Microsoft Power Platform or Dynamics 365, we can help.

items.question: What are the steps to creating an application?
items.answer: Proper planning before design is essential, whether it's heavy-code development or no-code/low-code app creation: define objectives and business needs, review requirements and user behavior, present a demo or proof of value, analyze the gaps, then present findings and an implementation proposal. We also offer several high-performance, ready-to-use solutions.

items.question: What are the benefits of M365 tool governance with Ø Studio?
items.answer: Stronger security and compliance through complete visibility and continuous monitoring, reduced costs through licence and resource management, automation of repetitive tasks, simpler adoption, management of roles, access and approvals, and a better user experience with friendly dashboards and reports.
